description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, finding R9/C2-adjacent (evidence pinned to
commit acfb8992).

sanitize_platform_options (benchbox/core/results/platform_options.py:68-80) is
used for platform.raw_config (platforms/base/runtime_metadata.py:105) but does
NOT filter _INTERNAL_OPTION_KEYS (only _iter_public_options does), and
_sanitize_option_value falls back to str(value) (platform_options.py:138). Net
effect: UnifiedTuningConfiguration objects are published as ~900-char Python
repr() strings at platform.raw_config.tuning_config - 468 of 528 seed-corpus
bundles carry one, and the explorer's tuning hash ends up hashing repr text.

anti_patterns.dont: silently drop values with no trace
anti_patterns.why: leave an explicit '<unserializable:TypeName>' marker so capture gaps stay visible

preserves.behavior: Bundle emission must never raise because an option value is unserializable

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/results -q -k 'platform_options or raw_config'
verifications.description: Sweep script over a fresh local run shows no repr strings
verifications.expected: All passing incl. new no-repr assertions

work_units.notes:
Added an opt-in exclude_internal keyword to sanitize_platform_options()
(default False, preserving existing call sites' behavior). When True it
drops underscore-prefixed keys and _INTERNAL_OPTION_KEYS, matching
_iter_public_options semantics, and propagates recursively through
nested Mapping values. Set exclude_internal=True at every export-facing
call site: runtime_metadata.py:105 (platform_raw_config, the leak site
named in the finding), runtime_metadata.py:450 (_raw_platform_metadata,
also published in bundles), and platform_options.py's
build_platform_options_capture (defense-in-depth; it already filtered
via _iter_public_options before calling sanitize, but nested Mapping
values weren't covered previously).
work_units.summary: Exclude internal option keys from raw_config capture (align sanitize_platform_options call sites with _iter_public_options filtering, or filter at the runtime_metadata call site)

work_units.notes:
_sanitize_option_value no longer falls back to str(value)/repr() for
any caller. If the value exposes a callable to_dict(), that result is
used (recursively sanitized, including secret redaction and, when
requested, internal-key filtering); if to_dict() raises, or the value
has no to_dict, the key's value becomes the marker string
"<unserializable:TypeName>" (key itself is preserved per the
anti_patterns note - only the opaque value is replaced). This applies
unconditionally (not just when exclude_internal=True) since there is no
legitimate reason to publish a raw Python repr from any call site.
Wrapped the to_dict() call in try/except so a broken to_dict()
implementation can't raise out of bundle emission.
work_units.summary: Replace the str() fallback for non-JSON-able values on exported paths: use to_dict() when available, else drop the key with a captured warning marker

work_units.notes:
tests/unit/core/results/test_platform_options_capture.py: added
test_sanitize_excludes_internal_keys_when_requested,
test_sanitize_without_exclude_internal_preserves_existing_behavior,
test_sanitize_uses_to_dict_for_objects_that_support_it,
test_sanitize_marks_unserializable_values_instead_of_using_repr,
test_sanitize_never_raises_when_to_dict_itself_fails, and
test_secret_redaction_unaffected_by_internal_key_filtering.
tests/unit/platforms/test_runtime_metadata_helpers.py: added
test_platform_raw_config_excludes_internal_tuning_keys_and_reprs, which
exercises build_default_normalized_result_metadata end-to-end with a
tuning-config-shaped object with a deliberately repr-leaking
__repr__ and asserts platform_raw_config has neither the internal keys
nor any repr text.
work_units.summary: Tests: a config object placed in options never serializes as a repr string in any exported payload; warning marker asserted for unknown objects
